direction: Evolve the multiplicative gate × rank-power ruin priority score toward a capacity/depot-aware hybrid: keep |removal_savings|/scale as the density-normalized base, but amplify the gate_load term (tight-capacity routes prioritized) and add an eccentric-depot radial gate that favors removing nodes far from the depot centroid, with the rank-power exponent p annealed as a function of stagnation_ratio and iter_frac so that early iterations diversify (broad top-q ruin) and stagnant phases intensify worst-removal.

operations.mechanism: Round 1 archive: single solver at mean objective 16.0429 over 24 instances, 206.2 ms mean (well inside the 500 ms deadline, so there is headroom for the LNS loop to run more/harder iterations). VBS==SBS means no complementarity yet — the only lever is improving the single hook. KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms cvrp_ruin_recreate/v1 exposes exactly one evolvable hook score_ruin_nodes(dm, demands, capacity, route_ids, route_loads, route_dists, removal_savings, stagnation_ratio, iter_frac) with fixed deterministic Regret-2 repair, intra_2opt and R2R acceptance, and that the winning M3 rule was a multiplicative gate + rank-power form — so the search space is (1) which gates to multiply, (2) the rank-power exponent schedule. The documented L3-ctrl baseline is pure worst-cost removal, so the deltas we seek are precisely in the gate design. Weakest-regime evidence says to weight capacity saturation and depot-eccentricity gating, and the KB's applicable_regimes explicitly lists 'stagnation_aware_diversification' as a strong point of this template, justifying an iter_frac/stagnation_ratio-annealed exponent rather than a static worst-removal. Postprocess stays 'none' because the only allowed mode is none and the skeleton already ends with intra_2opt + R2R acceptance.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 (500 ms budget) the weakest regimes are capacity_level=tight (vbs_rel_gap -22.25%), size=100 (-20.89%), spatial=clustered (-19.23%) and depot_style=eccentric (-19.83%). Because tight-capacity and eccentric-depot instances dominate the loss, a multiplication-based ruin score that (a) strongly gates on route-load saturation (route_loads/capacity) and (b) gates on radial distance from the depot will select ruin sets whose re-insertion by deterministic Regret-2 is much more constrained, yielding larger net tour-length reduction than the plain worst-cost/savings ranking; annealing p with stagnation_ratio should also avoid the R2R stagnation trap within the 500 ms anytime loop. Expected mean objective < 16.0429.
